en.dr-ali-peiravi: 3-169 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Sa’ed ibn Abdullah quoted on the authority of Ahmad ibn Aba Abdullah, on the authority of Al-Nahikee , on the authority of Mansoor ibn Yunus that he had heard Abal-Hassan Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim (MGB) say, “
There are no harms in the following three things: Al-Razeqi grapes, sugar canes and Lebanese apples.”
